rationale: Adds a per-binary unique Objective-C class helper to the generic platform layer: classes registered at run time under a name carrying the load address of the image, so two Pulp binaries in one host process never share a class and run each other's code. Additive, with no view or render dependency, and usable by any Apple view host, so the next Vellum re-export of core/platform should carry it.
